initial_Run_QA_refinements: These are actual programming obligations, with primary video, audio and captions and the statute's technically feasible program-related material, positioning and availability duties, not merely reservation of empty channels.

These are actual programming obligations, including primary video, audio and captions. Commercial carriage includes technically feasible program-related blanking-interval or subcarrier material; educational carriage includes technically feasible program-related ancillary material necessary for disability access, education or language purposes. Other ancillary material remains discretionary. Positioning and availability duties also constrain operation; the law does not merely reserve empty channels.
